evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability.
